bloques.titulo: The passive in Präteritum: wurde and wurden
texto: The **werden** Auxiliary in Präteritum (**wurde** for singular, **wurden** for plural) is built together with the **Partizip II** at the end of the prayer:
1. singular: **Der Serverausfall wurde in der Nacht behoben** (the server's fall was corrected during the night).
2. Plural: **Alle Dateien wurden rechtzeitig gespeichert** (all files were saved on time).
3. Style: In formal texts, news, work reports and technical manuals, passive in Präteritum is much more common than passive in Perfekt (**ist ... worden**).

frases.de: Wurde der Serverausfall von gestern geklärt?
frases.es: ¿Se aclaró la caída del servidor de ayer?
frases.en: Did it clear the fall of yesterday's server?

frases.de: Ja, das Problem wurde noch in der Nacht von den Technikern behoben.
frases.es: Sí, el problema fue solucionado aún por la noche por los técnicos.
frases.en: Yeah, the problem was solved even at night by the technicians.

frases.de: Nein, glücklicherweise wurden alle Sicherungskopien rechtzeitig gespeichert.
frases.es: No, afortunadamente todas las copias de seguridad fueron guardadas a tiempo.
frases.en: No, fortunately all the backup was saved in time.

bloques.pregunta: How is the use of «wurde» or «wurden» in the passive in Präteritum determined?

opciones.texto: Según el número gramatical del sujeto: «wurde» para singular y «wurden» para plural
opciones.explicacion: The verbal agreement strictly responds to the number of the subject in nominative.

opciones.texto: According to the preposition accompanying the agent («von» requests wurde, «durch» requests wurden)
opciones.explicacion: The prepositions do not determine the singular or plural conjugation of the auxiliary.

opciones.texto: Depending on the time of the day of the incident
opciones.explicacion: The temporal moment does not intervene in the morphological bending of the verb.

bloques.pregunta: In what area is passive in Präteritum particularly common?

opciones.texto: In technical reports, news, records and formal correspondence
opciones.explicacion: It is the preferred narrative and descriptive time in the formal German written record.

opciones.texto: Exclusivamente en mensajes instantáneos informales entre amigos
opciones.explicacion: In the oral colloquial record, the Perfekt or active voice with «man» predominates.

opciones.texto: Solo al formular deseos hipotéticos en condicional
opciones.explicacion: Unreal hypotheses require Konjunktiv II («würde»), not indicative Präteritum.

bloques.frase: Das Problem ___ noch in der Nacht von den Technikern behoben.

opciones.explicacion: With the singular neutral «das Problem» subject the correct form is «wurde».
It is a plural form; it would create discord with the singular subject.
It is present as an indication; it does not agree with facts already concluded.
The «alle Sicherungskopien» subject is plural, so requires the «wurden» auxiliary.
It is the form of singular, incompatible with a plural subject.
It is the active Plusquamperfekt auxiliary with intransitive verbs, not process passive.

bloques.pregunta: What does this security report confirm?
bloques.frase: Wichtige Daten wurden glücklicherweise nicht gelöscht.

opciones.texto: Fortunately, no important data were deleted.
opciones.explicacion: «wurden nicht gelöscht» confirms that the data was safe on the server.

opciones.texto: The staff lost the files for not keeping them in advance.
opciones.explicacion: It is in front contrast to the statement in the report.

opciones.texto: The files will be saved next week if there are no electrical cuts.
opciones.explicacion: It describes a past action already accomplished, not a plan conditioned to the future.
«Der Serverausfall» is a singular masculine noun that matches «wurde».
It is infinite or present of plural, incompatible with the sense of past.

bloques.explicacion: Wurde in second position and participle at the end.

intro: In order to document incidents, write records and report on past events, formal and journalistic German uses passive in Präteritum.
